content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I previously worked with a [product_name] featuring only digital inputs, so to deepen my knowledge, I obtained a 12/24V [product_name] with a [product_name] PT100 expansion module. I'm experiencing difficulties with getting the PT100 sensor to function properly. The module is connected and its LED indicates operation. I wired the sensor to the M1+ and M1- terminals, with a jumper between M1+ and IC1. In [product_name] V5, I assigned the input as AI3 because A1 and A2 are taken by the main unit. The setup operates correctly in simulation, but after uploading and running an online test on the actual hardware, there is no response. Does anyone have suggestions for why it's not working? Many thanks in advance,

Hello [user_name], Please review my example to observe how your parameters are influencing the sensor inputs. Assuming both the module and sensor are correct, the output signal will only be '1' when the temperature is at least 0.5°C and less than 3.0°C. Additionally, consider checking my previous responses regarding PT100 °C precision for advice on scaling the PT100 inputs to obtain precise readings. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello! Are you certain you have a PT100 sensor? Is it operating correctly? If you measure the resistance across the two main wires of a PT100, the value should be greater than 100 ohms (typically around 115-120 ohms depending on the ambient temperature).
Thank you very much, [user_name]. I have the PT100 sensor reading correctly now and found the information about precision valuable. Thanks again,
